measured_with.tool: torch.profiler(with_flops=True) on a full forward pass
measured_with.convention: 1 multiply-add = 2 FLOPs (torch.profiler and Ultralytics/THOP both use this)
measured_with.includes: backbone, neck, both Detect branches (one2many + one2one) and the decode step
measured_with.excludes: preprocessing, NMS, result construction, host-device transfer

fused_single_branch_graph.note: Detect.fuse() removes the unused one-to-one head; this is the deployment graph.

note: Param counts are for nc=9. The official YOLO26m at nc=80 has 21,896,248 params in the same dual-branch convention. FLOPs are not latency.
